title: IvPlayer

basic: N/A (not a game). BGM: No. Sound Effect: No.
N/A — packaged IPK in Seller Lounge (com.ivplayer.iptv_1.0.0_all.ipk)
guidelineDetail: Detailed InformationIvPlayer screens start on the next slides (Login / Start / Home / Channels / Player).UI language on TV is Turkish by default. English labels are in Settings → Dil.Replace sample images with 1920x1080 screenshots of IvPlayer before final submit if still showing template artwork.
loginDesc: No ID field. IvPlayer has no member login.
If limit is reached: email the on-screen Device Code to destek@ivplayer.tr
Then press Lisansı kontrol et on Home
loginDetail: Detailed InformationIvPlayer has NO user ID/password.Access is a device-bound SOFTWARE PLAYER LICENSE. The app does not sell TV channels, IPTV subscriptions, or channel packages.QA method A (recommended):1) Home → Kodum var2) Enter activation code LGQAIVPLAYER013) OK / Aktive etThe same code may be used on up to 20 QA devices.QA method B:1) Read 12-character Cihaz kodu on Home (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)2) Email destek@ivplayer.tr3) Seller binds a test license to that device4) Home → Lisansı kontrol etDo NOT complete a real payment on the website during QA.
startDesc: No Start button. App goes to Home automatically.
Back during splash: may exit to TV Launcher
startDetail: Detailed InformationCold start: LG splashBackground (webos/splash.png) then Home.There is no separate Start CTA.handlesRelaunch is true: re-open from Recent Apps restores the app without a permanent black screen.
homeDesc: Title: IvPlayer. Tagline: Smart TV için Premium Medya Oynatıcı
Cihaz kodu (12-char device code XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) — use this for website purchase / QA bind
Siteden satın al / ivplayer.tr/activation.html (opens buy page if browser allowed; URL is always shown)
Lisansı kontrol et — claim license after website bind
Kodum var — enter reseller / QA activation code
After license only: Playlist URL aç, M3U dosyası aç, Favoriler, Geçmiş
Back on Home: exit to TV Launcher
homeDetail: Detailed InformationSTORE BUILD: until licensed, Open URL / Open File / Favorites / History / recent playlists are HIDDEN.Visible when unlicensed: device code, Lisansı kontrol et, Kodum var, Ayarlar.After license: license plan + expiry appear. User loads their OWN M3U/M3U8 (no channels are bundled).Invalid code → Turkish error, stay on dialog.Network error → friendly message, no crash.
flowDetail: Detailed InformationLauncher → Splash → Home (unlicensed)Home → Kodum var (code) OR Lisansı kontrol et (after bind) → Home (licensed)Licensed Home → Playlist URL aç OR M3U dosyası aç → Categories → Channel list → PlayerPlayer Back → Channel list → Categories / HomeHome → Ayarlar → Back → HomeHome → Favoriler / Geçmiş (licensed + playlist loaded)Remote: D-pad moves focus, OK activates, Back goes one screen back.Magic Remote pointer is optional; D-pad is primary.
channelsDesc: ← Ana Sayfa / ← Tüm kategoriler / Back — return to previous screen
Category tiles (Canlı TV / Filmler / Diziler) then channel list
OK on a channel — open Player
Large playlists: wait for category grid (Hazırlanıyor…)
channelsDetail: Detailed InformationContent comes only from the user-supplied M3U/M3U8. IvPlayer does not provide a channel pack.If no playlist is loaded, this screen is not reachable.Search: type on screen keyboard if shown, or filter list.Back from channel list returns to categories, then Home.
playerDesc: Back / Geri — return to channel list (does not exit the app)
← / → — seek 30s (VOD only; live has no seek)
On-screen: Oynat/Duraklat, Durdur, Favori, Ses, Görüntü, Tam ekran
playerDetail: Detailed InformationPlayback quality depends on the user's stream URL, not on bundled TV content.On error: show message + Yeniden dene. No white/black crash screen.Back from Player → channel list. Back again → categories/Home.Do not treat a failed third-party stream as an app crash if the UI remains usable.
paidDesc: No in-app payment UI. This screen does not exist in the app.
Payment is on the website only: https://ivplayer.tr/activation.html (PayTR).
Sold item: IvPlayer software license (1 year or lifetime). NOT IPTV / channels.
QA must NOT pay. Use activation code LGQAIVPLAYER01 (Home → Kodum var).
N/A — no in-app credit card form
Or bind the on-screen Device Code via destek@ivplayer.tr
paidDetail: Detailed InformationPaid content is OUTSIDE the app (LG UX note 6): website checkout via PayTR.Plans: 1-year software license and lifetime software license.IvPlayer does not provide TV channels, IPTV subscriptions, or channel packages.LG QA: do not use real cards. Do not require testers to purchase.After QA license: load any authorized test M3U/M3U8 with Playlist URL aç.
adBannerDesc: Page: none — IvPlayer has no in-app ads
adBannerDetail: Detailed InformationIn-App Ad = Not Applicable. No banner, no third-party ad SDK.
adVideoDetail: Detailed InformationNo AVOD / preroll / midroll ads. Player only plays the user playlist stream.
appendix: If you have anything to let the LG QA Management know, please comment here.1. Product positioning: IvPlayer is a free LG webOS media player. It does not provide any TV channels, IPTV subscription, or channel package. Users play their own authorized M3U/M3U8 playlist after a software license.2. QA login: no ID/PW. Home → Kodum var → LGQAIVPLAYER01 (up to 20 devices). Or email the Home device code to destek@ivplayer.tr and press Lisansı kontrol et after bind.3. After license: Playlist URL aç → paste a legal test M3U/M3U8. Do not expect built-in channels.4. Remote: D-pad + OK + Back. Player: OK controls, Up/Down channel, Left/Right seek (VOD), Back to list.5. Unlicensed Home hides URL/file pickers. That is intended (store build).6. Support: destek@ivplayer.tr · https://ivplayer.tr/support.html · Privacy: https://ivplayer.tr/privacy.html7. Please ignore template sample artwork if still visible; use IvPlayer screenshots (1920x1080) in Seller Lounge Images as well.
